editorial_intent: A relaxed, sociable short break in Lisbon: start with hillside views, take a yellow tram into old neighbourhood streets, drift through Praça do Comércio and finish beside the Tagus.
share_reason: Send it to a friend as a doable European city weekend with a tram ride, a scenic wander, a square full of atmosphere and a relaxed riverside finish, not a strenuous expedition.
caption:
A city break that doesn't need a complicated itinerary. 🇵🇹

Lisbon is made for wandering slowly: start with rooftops and viewpoints around Alfama, ride one of the city's historic yellow trams, stroll through Praça do Comércio and finish with some time beside the Tagus at Ribeira das Naus.

It's a good place to plan a long weekend around neighbourhoods rather than rushing from one sight to the next. Expect hills and cobbles in the older districts, and use the trams to make the climbs easier.

Send this to the friend you'd bring for a few days away. 🌞
